title: Threading a frame as the key invariant through a raw for-loop
intent: Turn a raw for-loop whose per-iteration triple carries an invariant INV xs i into a whole-loop triple with arbitrary postconditions psi, rho, chi, by strengthening the loop invariant to INV xs i star ?pc, where ?pc is a frame of magic wands that converts the terminal invariant and the per-iteration tau/theta into the target postconditions.

parent.name: sstriple_raw_for_loop_framed'
parent.statement:
lemma sstriple_raw_for_loop_framed':
    notes aentails_intro [intro]
    fixes INV :: \<open>'t list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a assert\<close>
  assumes \<open>\<And>i. (i < length xs) \<Longrightarrow> (\<Gamma> ; INV xs i \<turnstile> f (xs ! i) \<stileturn> (\<lambda>_. INV xs (i+1)) \<bowtie> \<tau> \<bowtie> \<theta>)\<close>
    shows \<open>\<Gamma> ; INV xs 0 \<star> (INV xs (length xs) \<Zsurj> \<psi> ()) \<sqinter> (\<Sqinter>r. \<tau> r \<Zsurj> \<rho> r) \<sqinter> (\<Sqinter>r. \<theta> r \<Zsurj> \<chi> r) \<turnstile> raw_for_loop xs f \<stileturn> \<psi> \<bowtie> \<rho> \<bowtie> \<chi>\<close>

children.name: sstriple_frame_rule
children.statement:
theorem sstriple_frame_rule:
  assumes \<open>\<Gamma> ; \<phi> \<turnstile> e \<stileturn> \<psi> \<bowtie> \<rho> \<bowtie> \<theta>\<close>
    shows \<open>\<Gamma> ; \<phi> \<star> \<xi> \<turnstile> e \<stileturn> (\<lambda>r. \<psi> r \<star> \<xi>) \<bowtie> (\<lambda>r. \<rho> r \<star> \<xi>)\<bowtie> (\<lambda>a. \<theta> a \<star> \<xi>)\<close>
children.closed_by: intro sstriple_from_stripleI; clarsimp simp add: sstriple_striple striple_frame_rule is_local_frame
children.note: Adds a separating-conjunct frame xi to every component of a triple (precondition and all three postconditions); closes by one intro of sstriple_from_stripleI.

children.name: sstriple_raw_for_loop'
children.statement:
lemma sstriple_raw_for_loop':
    fixes I :: \<open>'t list \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a assert\<close>
  assumes \<open>\<And>i. i < length xs \<Longrightarrow> (\<Gamma> ; I xs i \<turnstile> f (xs ! i) \<stileturn> (\<lambda>_. I xs (i+1)) \<bowtie> \<rho> \<bowtie> \<theta>)\<close>
    shows \<open>\<Gamma> ; I xs 0 \<turnstile> raw_for_loop xs f \<stileturn> (\<lambda>_. I xs (length xs)) \<bowtie> \<rho> \<bowtie> \<theta>\<close>
children.closed_by: induction xs arbitrary: I (base: simp add: raw_for_loop_nil sstriple_skipI; step: auto intro: sstriple_bindI)
children.note: The unframed for-loop rule, over the list-indexed invariant I xs i; proved by induction on xs, with the base closed by sstriple_skipI and the step by sstriple_bindI.

children.name: sstriple_consequence
children.statement:
lemma sstriple_consequence:
  assumes \<open>\<Gamma> ; \<phi>' \<turnstile> e \<stileturn> \<psi>' \<bowtie> \<rho>' \<bowtie> \<theta>'\<close>
      and \<open>\<phi> \<longlongrightarrow> \<phi>'\<close>
      and \<open>\<And>r. \<psi>' r \<longlongrightarrow> \<psi> r\<close>
      and \<open>\<And>r. \<rho>' r \<longlongrightarrow> \<rho> r\<close>
      and \<open>\<And>a. \<theta>' a \<longlongrightarrow> \<theta> a\<close>
    shows \<open>\<Gamma> ; \<phi> \<turnstile> e \<stileturn> \<psi> \<bowtie> \<rho> \<bowtie> \<theta>\<close>
children.closed_by: is_local_weaken; intro sstriple_from_stripleI; clarsimp simp add: sstriple_striple striple_consequence
children.note: Rule of consequence: strengthens the precondition and each postcondition of a triple.

applicability.goal_shape: A loop triple Gamma ; INV xs 0 star F |- raw_for_loop xs f {psi} {rho} {chi} where the per-iteration step establishes Gamma ; INV xs i |- f (xs ! i) {_. INV xs (i+1)} {tau} {theta}, and the target postconditions psi/rho/chi differ from the iteration's tau/theta; the frame F is a separating-conjunct carrier of magic wands that link them.
applicability.use_when: the loop has a clean per-iteration invariant INV but the client wants different postconditions; the link between iteration postconditions and final postconditions is expressible as magic wands (Zsurj) held in a separating-conjunct frame.
applicability.avoid_when: the per-iteration invariant itself needs strengthening (then strengthen INV first); the target postcondition cannot be phrased as a wand that is sound under the separating conjunction; the loop is a bounded while with a separate condition step (use sstriple_bounded_while_framed instead).

consequences: The move creates one side condition per component: tau r star ?pc --> rho r and theta a star ?pc --> chi a for the return/abort frames, plus INV xs (length xs) star ?pc --> psi () for the terminal invariant, each discharged by aentails reasoning (meson/metis) over the wand structure. Failure mode: if the frame ?pc cannot be separated cleanly from the invariant, the final sstriple_consequence transports fail. The whole proof depends on sstriple_frame_rule distributing ?pc through every component of the per-iteration triple.
